DecimalWire.description:
Exact decimal encoded only as a JSON string.

Restoration routes through [`crate::decimal::parse_decimal`], the single
exact text-admission rule: JSON numbers, malformed text and inexact values
are rejected rather than rounded. Serialization writes canonical
fixed-point text with trailing zeros removed and signed zero normalized
(`"1.5"`, `"0"`), never scientific notation.

EclBucket.description: ECL result for a single time bucket.

discount_factor.description: Discount factor at the bucket midpoint, or at recovery for Stage 3.

marginal_pd.description:
Unconditional default probability for the bucket,
`cumPD(t_end) - cumPD(t_start)`. This is the quantity that
multiplies `LGD * EAD * DF` for performing exposures. Stage 3
sets it to one and measures EAD less discounted recoveries.

EclResult.description: ECL result for a single exposure under a single scenario.

ecl.description: Total ECL for this exposure under this scenario.

meta.description: Audit stamp: numeric mode, rounding context, and FX policy in force.

oneOf.description: Weight was exactly zero. No forecast or repricing was run.
Positive-weight scenario with measured allowance and bucket detail.

result.description: Complete same-basis allowance from the admitted PD and LGD.

weighted_allowance.description: Weighted contribution to the total on the same basis.

oneOf.description: Positive-weight scenario whose measurement evidence is incomplete.

reason.description: Explanation of the required source evidence that is missing.

EclScenarioOutcome.description: One admissible macro-scenario row and its measured or missing allowance.

id.description: Explicit scenario identity in the portfolio policy's declared order.

lgd_override.description: Elected scenario LGD override as a decimal fraction.

weight.description: Exact scenario probability as supplied, including any zero-weight rows.

PositiveF64Wire.description:
Finite JSON number that is strictly greater than zero.

This type is used by serde field adapters so runtime deserialization and
generated schemas enforce the same positive-number contract.

fx_policy_applied.description: Optional FX policy applied by the computing layer (human-readable key).

numeric_mode.description:
Numeric engine mode used to produce the results.

Always [`NUMERIC_MODE_F64`] today; a plain string so result
envelopes stay wire-compatible across host languages.

parallel.description:
Whether the producing computation ran in parallel.

Serial results omit the field entirely so existing payloads and golden
files stay byte-identical.

rounding.description: Rounding context snapshot applied to IO boundaries.

timestamp.description:
Timestamp when result was computed (ISO 8601 format).
Useful for audit trails and reproducibility.

version.description: Finstack Quant library version used to produce the result.

RoundingContext.description:
Snapshot of active rounding settings used for result stamping.

Instances are produced from a [`FinstackConfig`] via `RoundingContext::from` and persisted
alongside valuation results.

ingest_scale_by_currency.description: Validated ingest scale snapshot by currency code, with values in `0..=28`.

mode.description: Explicitly selected rounding mode; absent when none was selected.

output_scale_by_currency.description: Validated output scale snapshot by currency code, with values in `0..=28`.

tolerances.description: Tolerance settings snapshot for floating-point comparisons.

oneOf.description: Nearest; an exact midpoint goes to the even coefficient.

Nearest; an exact midpoint increases absolute magnitude. Other
fractions round to nearest (`1.1` -> `1`), not away from zero.

Stage.description:
IFRS 9 impairment stage for a credit exposure.

Under IFRS 9, financial instruments are classified into three stages that
determine the ECL measurement horizon:

- **Stage 1**: 12-month ECL (no significant increase in credit risk)
- **Stage 2**: Lifetime ECL (significant increase in credit risk detected)
- **Stage 3**: Lifetime ECL (credit-impaired, objective evidence of default)

# References

IFRS 9 Financial Instruments, Section 5.5 -- Impairment. `docs/REFERENCES.md#ifrs-9-impairment`

oneOf.description:
Performing -- 12-month ECL. No significant increase in credit risk
since initial recognition.

Underperforming -- lifetime ECL. Significant increase in credit risk
(SICR) detected but not yet credit-impaired.

Non-performing -- lifetime ECL. Credit-impaired (objective evidence of
default: DPD >= 90, restructuring, etc.).

generic_epsilon.description:
Epsilon for generic floating-point comparisons (default: 1e-10).

Used for general numerical comparisons where higher tolerance is acceptable.

description: Probability-weighted ECL across macro scenarios with the per-scenario audit trail.

ecl.description: Aggregate allowance, absent when any positive-probability scenario is missing.

meta.description: Numeric and reporting provenance of the complete or partial calculation.

scenario_breakdown.description: Elected scenarios in caller order, including zero-weight entries.
